description: Vanguardia MGSA desarrolla una arquitectura CDSS y triaje determinista offline-first para exploración profunda (Artemis/Marte) y EIMO. Integra monitorización de SANS, modelos causales con DAGs de NASA (NASA/TP-20220015709) y cómputo local resiliente. Registro técnico y software: DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.13362039
summary: VMED-Core is an offline-first clinical decision support and health monitoring web application built for long-duration spaceflight under communication delays. Grounded in NASA Human Research Program hazards and NASA OSDR datasets, it combines edge ophthalmic B-mode ultrasound metrics (ONSD, posterior globe flattening, optic disc edema) with vital signs, sleep, mood, and hepatic/renal pharmacokinetic flags. Using deterministic Clinical Quality Language (CQL) rules rather than probabilistic AI guessing, VMED-Core computes longitudinal Delta-ONSD against each astronaut's pre-flight baseline, enforces a post-exercise re-evaluation gate (IEC 62366-1), and outputs color-coded triage tiers (Routine, Monitor, Urgent) with actionable crew guidance and store-and-forward Flight Surgeon packets.
